eyebrow: A nonce is just a counter
code:
Account sends: nonce 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, ...

If nonce 3 never confirms (gas price too low):
  nonce 4 and 5 are STUCK behind it,
  even though they're individually valid
caption: A node won't include nonce N+1 until nonce N has landed.
Two requests racing on "latest" can collide on the same nonce.
Too low a limit reverts out of gas -- and you still pay for it.

steps.label: Speed up
steps.sub: Resend the stuck nonce with a higher maxFeePerGas

steps.label: Cancel
steps.sub: Resend the stuck nonce as a 0 ETH transfer to yourself
